capabilities: embed provider CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, Kimi, OpenCode, Antigravity, DeepSeek, Pi) in a sidebar chat
resolve vault context via @note and @folder references and drag-and-drop
distill session decisions into a .claudian-plus/memory.md file and inject it into later prompts
render agent answers as native Obsidian DOM from claudian-ui code blocks with 54 components and actions
run commands like inline AI edit, note summarization, tag suggestions, MOC creation, and Canvas write undo
disambiguation: Despite the name, Claude is not the default provider — Codex is, and six other agent CLIs run over the same sessions.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. Codian-derived code carries AGPL-3.0 obligations while the rest is MIT. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Claudian Plus is built on two upstream open-source projects.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run AI coding agents, and typical AI extensions tie users to one vendor's model and erase session context when a window closes.

relations.evidence: Claudian Plus is built on two upstream open-source projects.

requires.name: at least one provider CLI (Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, DeepSeek Harness, Kimi, OpenCode, or Pi)
Node.js (for building from source and for the DeepSeek Harness provider)

summary: Embeds provider-backed coding agents in an Obsidian sidebar with multi-provider sessions, local memory distillation, and native UI rendering.
